title: Manage your workers' portable long service (building and construction)
summary: This page explains the portable long service scheme for building and construction workers in NSW and how employers can manage transactions online.
intro:
The Long Service Corporation (LSC) administers a portable long service scheme for building and construction workers in NSW. The scheme allows eligible workers in the industry to work for different employers, or as contractors, and qualify for a long service benefit.

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your LSC account, or register as an employer.

more_info.text: The scheme is funded by a levy applied to all NSW building and construction projects of $250,000 or more (inc. GST). The current rate is 0.25% of the total cost of the work.
